facts.fact: Sierra Leone's Ministry of Communication, Technology & Innovation, with the Public Service Academy and others, says it is training staff across ministries, departments and agencies, and its Cohort 1 of administrative staff, ending 25 September 2026, learned AI tools and Google Workspace registers in week two.
facts.system: Digital skills training for civil servants, Cohort 1

SLE.note: The training is for civil servants only, which this study does not count.
